limits: It does not see what a server does with the folder it is given, a grant made outside the arguments a client file holds, or every environment variable.

It does not see injection through an argument of a tool that runs a fixed program, whether a server filters the command, servers that run as local processes, or code interpreters whose parameter is code.
It does not see memory poisoned while an agent runs, memory a product keeps outside files, memory that is already poisoned, or a write made by code the text does not describe.
